cases.name: cover-inherited-overloads
cases.source: interface Base { visit(kind: 'text', callback: (value: string) => void): void; visit(kind: 'count', callback: (value: number) => void): void; } interface Child extends Base { visit(kind: 'flag', callback: (value: boolean) => void): void; visit(kind: 'count', callback: (value: number) => void): void; visit(kind: 'text', callback: (value: string) => void): void; }

cases.name: specialized-parent
cases.source: interface Base<T> { visit(kind: string, callback: (value: T) => void): void; } interface Child extends Base<string> { visit(kind: 'count', callback: (value: number) => void): void; visit(kind: string, callback: (value: string) => void): void; }

cases.name: missing-inherited-signature
cases.source: interface Base { visit(kind: 'text', callback: (value: string) => void): void; visit(kind: 'count', callback: (value: number) => void): void; } interface Child extends Base { visit(kind: 'flag', callback: (value: boolean) => void): void; visit(kind: 'text', callback: (value: string) => void): void; }

diagnostics.message: Interface 'Child' incorrectly extends interface 'Base'.   Types of property 'visit' are incompatible.     Type '{ (kind: "flag", callback: (value: boolean) => void): void; (kind: "text", callback: (value: string) => void): void; }' is not assignable to type '{ (kind: "text", callback: (value: string) => void): void; (kind: "count", callback: (value: number) => void): void; }'.       Types of parameters 'kind' and 'kind' are incompatible.         Type '"count"' is not assignable to type '"flag"'.

cases.name: incompatible-result
cases.source: interface Base { visit(kind: string): number; } interface Child extends Base { visit(kind: 'count'): boolean; visit(kind: string): string; }

diagnostics.message: Interface 'Child' incorrectly extends interface 'Base'.   The types returned by 'visit(...)' are incompatible between these types.     Type 'boolean' is not assignable to type 'number'.

cases.name: incompatible-callback
cases.source: interface Base { visit(kind: 'text', callback: (value: string) => void): void; } interface Child extends Base { visit(kind: 'count', callback: (value: number) => void): void; }

diagnostics.message: Interface 'Child' incorrectly extends interface 'Base'.   Types of property 'visit' are incompatible.     Type '(kind: "count", callback: (value: number) => void) => void' is not assignable to type '(kind: "text", callback: (value: string) => void) => void'.       Types of parameters 'kind' and 'kind' are incompatible.         Type '"text"' is not assignable to type '"count"'.

cases.name: optional-override
cases.source: interface Base { visit(kind: string): void; } interface Child extends Base { visit?(kind: string): void; }

diagnostics.message: Interface 'Child' incorrectly extends interface 'Base'.   Types of property 'visit' are incompatible.     Type '((kind: string) => void) | undefined' is not assignable to type '(kind: string) => void'.       Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type '(kind: string) => void'.
